study type: Cohort study (not explicitly stated, but implied)
outcome: Number of babies needing formula supplementation
finding: Using Early Weight Loss Nomograms, as opposed to a weight loss percentage protocol, was associated with higher rates of exclusive breastfeeding, particularly in babies born by cesarean section.
mod_finding: Babies born by cesarean section had significantly higher rates of exclusive breastfeeding when using the Early Weight Loss Nomograms compared to a weight loss percentage protocol (89.2% vs. 64.2%, p=0.001).
